sales_hooks: Broadcom is the 'arms dealer' of the ASIC economy — Google, Meta, and ByteDance all route their custom AI silicon through Broadcom. HBM qualification must happen at Broadcom before it reaches the hyperscaler's TPU.
Broadcom AI revenue run rate: $4.1B/quarter and accelerating — every ASIC win at a hyperscaler adds a new HBM demand channel that bypasses NVIDIA's supply chain.
ByteDance ASIC reportedly the largest single ASIC order in history — if it ships with HBM, understanding Broadcom's supplier selection process is critical for memory marketing teams.
Broadcom's SerDes IP is the interconnect between HBM and the compute die — memory suppliers who co-optimize with Broadcom's signal integrity requirements win design-ins earlier.

competitive_position.vs_marvell: Broadcom leads on compute ASICs (TPU/NPU); Marvell stronger on networking/DPU ASICs
competitive_position.vs_nvidia: ASIC displaces GPU for predictable inference; Broadcom captures margin NVIDIA would have taken
competitive_position.moat: Multi-generation co-design relationships with hyperscalers; 5-year design cycle creates lock-in

scm_engagement.scm_role: Designs the custom AI ASIC dies that hyperscalers use instead of NVIDIA GPUs (Google TPU, Meta MTIA, ByteDance custom chip). Also makes the high-speed SerDes (signal integrity IP) and Ethernet/InfiniBand switch ASICs that connect AI servers in a cluster. Broadcom is the 'behind-the-scenes' chip designer for the entire AI ASIC economy.
